profile.headline: Software Engineer at 100Devs | React.js | Javascript | Express.js | HTML | Node.js
profile.summary: Creative, detail-oriented, adaptive software engineer deeply interested in building innovative software solutions. Proven track record of creating and implementing successful front and back-end web applications using JavaScript with an overarching vision and a client-facing approach.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Collaborated with a team of developers to build modern and responsive web applications using best practices 

Built semantically structured full stack web applications

positions.title: Security Officer
positions.description:
Resolved conflicts using de-escalation techniques.

Ensured safety and order by closely monitoring and managing situations.

Provided a professional and welcoming environment for clientele.

 • Conduct weekly data analysis to optimize PPC campaigns
